recommendation.headline: Paper tracking recommended; live capital waits.
recommendation.summary: BTC 5% and 7.5% SuperTrend satellite caps are the preferred first paper-tracking candidates. BTC 10% remains the historical winner and growth observation candidate, but it depends more visibly on future BTC trend contribution.

paperTradingRules.rule: 原三资产 RiskParity 核心 + BTC SuperTrend 卫星
5% 和 7.5%；10% 作为进攻候选继续观察
每 10 个 ETF 交易日检查一次
BTC close > SuperTrend line 时卫星开启，否则卫星仓位进入现金
信号日收盘后计算，下一交易日执行；纸面记录 next-open 与 next-close 两套价格
目标权重变化小于 1% 可不交易；BTC 开关变化必须记录
至少记录 20 bps 成本 + 10 bps 滑点压力版本
策略相对原 RP 的最大回撤优势连续 3 个月消失，或 BTC 卫星触发超过预设亏损阈值时暂停复核
至少 3 个月，覆盖不少于 6 次调仓检查

riskNotes.title: BTC trend contribution can disappear
riskNotes.body: The satellite does not require BTC to repeat the last decade, but it still needs some future positive trend return.

riskNotes.title: Core assets still drive the portfolio
riskNotes.body: The BTC sleeve is an enhancement layer. If the three-asset RiskParity core weakens sharply, the satellite cannot rescue the whole portfolio.

riskNotes.title: Execution assumptions are incomplete
riskNotes.body: Actual BTC access, tax, spread, premium or discount, trading-hour mismatch, and account constraints still need paper-trading evidence.
